# GitHub Copilot instructions

Maximilian is a dependency-free C++ audio synthesis library. Before suggesting code for
this repository, read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — it is the canonical onboarding document,
and it is kept accurate by `tools/check-docs.py`.

The three things most likely to matter for a suggestion here:

1. **You do not write a `main()`.** The library exposes `void setup()` and
   `void play(double *output)`; a host (RtAudio, a browser worklet, an MCU ISR) calls them.
   `play()` runs once per sample, 44,100 times a second.
2. **`play()` must not allocate, log, lock or do file I/O.** Use `setup()` for that, and
   `maxiPoll::poll(value, hz, "label")` if you need to print from the audio path.
3. **Units differ inside the same class.** `maxiFilter::lores/hires/bandpass` take the
   cutoff in Hz; `maxiFilter::lopass/hipass` take a normalised 0–1 value.

Where to look for more:

| Topic | File |
|---|---|
| Setup, architecture, build and verify | [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) |
| Class-by-class API with units | [`agents/reference/api.md`](../agents/reference/api.md) |
| Failures people actually hit | [`agents/reference/pitfalls.md`](../agents/reference/pitfalls.md) |
| Which examples still compile | [`agents/reference/examples-map.md`](../agents/reference/examples-map.md) |
| Task-shaped recipes | [`agents/skills/`](../agents/skills/) |

Note that **four of the shipped examples do not compile** against the current headers
(`7.Counting1`, `19.Enveloping2`, `20.FFT_example` on 32-bit, `21.Recording`). Do not use
them as a source of truth without checking `agents/reference/examples-map.md` first.

Do not hand-edit `docs/docbuild/xml/` (generated by Doxygen) or `docs/*.html` (generated by
Sphinx and published to GitHub Pages).
